name: custos_prompt_mark
comment: The refused-PROMPT mark on an agent's certificate, one row per agent: set STANDING by the landing job when it refuses PROMPT (TPS 5.14.5), which then refuses every op under that certificate; turned CLEARED only by the Operator's Custos:Certify writing the certificate again. A row is never deleted.

columns.name: cpm_agent
columns.comment: The agent account's user name, as custos_certificate's cc_agent

columns.name: cpm_state
columns.comment: STANDING or CLEARED; STANDING refuses every op under the certificate

columns.name: cpm_marked
columns.comment: The server time, whole seconds, the standing mark was set

columns.name: cpm_cleared
columns.comment: The server time, whole seconds, a re-certification cleared it; 0 while it stands
